items.heading: Adoption of Fiscal Years 2027 and 2028 Biennial Budget and Fiscal Years 2027 – 2031 Capital Improvement Program
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Tregub/Taplin) to accept revised material from the City Manager for consideration. Vote: All Ayes. Recess 8:31 p.m. – 9:10 p.m. Action: M/S/Failed (Kesarwani/Blackaby) to adopt a resolution adopting the Fiscal Years 2027 & 2028 (“FY27 and FY28”) Biennial Budget and the Fiscal Years 2027 – 2031 Capital Improvement Program (Five-Year CIP) as contained in the City Manager’s FY27 & FY28 Proposed Biennial Budget, and authorizing the City Manager to provide applicable advances to community agencies receiving City funds in FY27, including the amendments in the revised material in the Supplemental 2 Packet from the City Manager and the revised material provided by the City Manager at the meeting, and including the revisions and allocations presented by Mayor Ishii and as further revised at the meeting by Council action as noted below: • Accept the allocations in the Mayor’s supplemental budget recommendations, presented by Mayor Ishii at the meeting, with the exception that for Small Sites, $2,500,000 will be retained for Small Sites, and $1,300,000 will be retained in the Housing Trust Fund for Affordable Housing. Action Calendar – New Business • In the CIP, move the following four items to the “unfunded and pending” status, pending further review by staff and the Safe Streets Oversight Committee: o Citywide Traffic Signal Master Plan o Transportation Design Guideline Study o Transportation Nexus Study o Vision Zero Action Plan update Phased Implementation Roadmap • In both FY 2027 and FY 2028 increase the amount of the revenue transfer for the Annual Ambulance Transport Revenue by $200,000 to fund the 9.0 positions in the Fire Department. • Clarify that the revenue transfer of $25,000 in FY 2028 for the Euclid Street Garbage Corral Design is a reduction to the budget, rather than a relinquishment of funds. • Add clarifying language regarding Small Sites that the acquisition needs to take place within 36 months of the non-profit receiving the funding from the City, otherwise the funding is to be returned to the City. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Blackaby; Noes – Bartlett, Tregub, O’Keefe, Lunaparra, Ishii; Abstain – Humbert; Absent – None. Action: 92 speakers. M/S/Carried (Humbert/Tregub) to adopt Resolution No. 72,340–N.S. adopting the Fiscal Years 2027 & 2028 (“FY27 and FY28”) Biennial Budget and the Fiscal Years 2027 – 2031 Capital Improvement Program (Five-Year CIP) as contained in the City Manager’s FY27 & FY28 Proposed Biennial Budget, and authorizing the City Manager to provide applicable advances to community agencies receiving City funds in FY27, including the amendments in the revised material in the Supplemental 2 Packet from the City Manager and the revised material provided by the City Manager at the meeting, and including the revisions and allocations presented by Mayor Ishii in the Supplemental Budget Recommendations and as further revised at the meeting by Council action as noted below: • In the CIP, move the following four items to the “unfunded and pending” status, pending further review by staff and the Safe Streets Oversight Committee: o Citywide Traffic Signal Master Plan o Transportation Design Guideline Study o Transportation Nexus Study o Vision Zero Action Plan update Phased Implementation Roadmap • In both FY 2027 and FY 2028 increase the amount of the revenue transfer for the Annual Ambulance Transport Revenue by $200,000 to fund the 9.0 positions in the Fire Department (for a total of $978,334 in FY 2027 as reflected in the table below). • Clarify that the revenue transfer of $25,000 in FY 2028 for the Euclid Street Garbage Corral Design is a reduction to the District 6 office budget, rather than a relinquishment of funds. • Add clarifying language regarding Small Sites that the acquisition of property needs to take place within 36 months of the non-profit receiving the funding from the City, otherwise the funding is to be returned to the City.
